integrity: The theorem has a self-contained all-size proof using principal-upset equality and a completed-suffix transfer; finite tests independently corroborate 449 small source/target pairs. The 2025 motivating source first-public date is its arXiv v1 submission, not its 2025-09-14 revision. Independent audit not performed.
limitations: Counts surjective bounded morphisms between fixed labelled finite ordinal sums of antichains, not arbitrary finite posets or isomorphism classes. No unrestricted logic-containment claim is made. Historically equivalent formulas may exist outside inspected records.
title: Exact bounded-morphism transfer on finite layered intuitionistic frames
